questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 1. A body of mass 2.5 kg falls from a height of 0.5 m on a spring. If the spring constant of the spring is $1950 \mathrm{Nm}^{-1}$, find the maximum contraction of the spring.

questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 2. An elevator of mass 4000 kg carrying a box of mass 240 kg . When the upward tension in the supporting cable is 48000 N , calculate the upward acceleration and rising distance after 3 s from starting.

questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 3. Two heat engines are active at $400 \mathrm{~K}$ and $800 \mathrm{~K}$ temperature respectively. The specific heat of the fuel used in the two engines are $2000 \mathrm{Jkg}^{-1} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ and $1500 \mathrm{Jkg}^{-1} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ respectively. Two different effective matters of $10 \mathrm{gm}$ mass are used in two different engines.

questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 6. A ball is dropped from a height of 60 m and after striking the ground it loses $75 \%$ of its energy, calculate its rebound height.

questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 7. A photon of wavelength $0.40 \mathrm{~nm}$ strikes an electron at rest and rebounds at an angle of $150^{\circ}$ with respect to its original direction. Find the speed and wavelength of the photon after the collision.

questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 8. The water tap is turned off after using. Even then droplets of water were falling. If the surface tension of water is $72 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{Nm}^{-1}$, then (i) What will be the diameter of the bigger water droplet? (ii) What will be the increased temperature of water?

questions.subject: Physics (10)
questions.question: 9. An electron moves with $10^{5} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ velocity making $60^{\circ}$ angle with the magnetic field of 0.5 Tesla. Find the force acting on the electron.
